checks.baseline: S0 preserves old autograd graph; fresh S0 phase precedes PASS baseline reproduction gate for every S1/S2/S3 job. Frozen mean .001 and per-row .01 AbsRel reproduction tolerances, no automatic relaxation; expected CUDA finite tolerance versus exact synthetic CPU comparison.
checks.free_loss: Per-ray mean alpha for t<d-tau only, then all valid rays average; empty free sets and misses contribute zero. No behind-surface empty label.
checks.holdout: Both runner and evaluator require exposed allowlist disjoint from holdout; evaluator verifies all136 states and source/completion hashes before media reads.
checks.matched_rng: Deterministic old DirectState initial values. Seed excludes variant and matches old scene|role|RGBD. Per-run local Generator, same randint cardinality and one draw per step; geometry/full objective uses no generator. Full int64 sampled stream SHA and init state hash must match across four variants before formal completion.
checks.query_isolation: Runner supplies only ContextOnlyLoader RGBD batch; optimizer rejects non-context supervision and has no query/lambda API. No query access, score selection, model/writer imports in optimizer.
checks.renderer_geometry: Exact midpoint fractions(i+.5)/64, cached hit near/far, softplus density*hit, common delta=(far-near)/64 including last sample, alpha=1-exp(-density*delta), cumulative transmittance with 1e-10; no changed ray depth semantics.
checks.spacing: tau=.5*L2(extent/16); renderer normals and old TV regularizer both use extent/grid-size rather than extent/(grid-size-1).
checks.state_selection: Fixed final10000 state for all variants; full context checkpoints are diagnostic, no query/context-selected checkpoint adaptation.
checks.surface_empty: EPS finite, eligible multiplication and clamped denominator yield zero additional loss/gradient for all-empty surface supervision, no log(0).
checks.surface_gradient: Band labels are fixed context depth; gradients through alpha/transmittance permit both near-surface mass increase and reducing preceding occluders. No claim gradients only touch band density: mass depends on preceding transmittance.
checks.surface_loss: -log(sum band weights+1e-8), average over valid-depth hit rays with nonempty band. Empty/miss excluded only extra term and counted. Exact old RGB/rendered-depth losses retained.

interpretation_limits: Surface supervision is restricted to representable hit rays with sampled band; coverage counts must accompany conclusions, no deletion from overall query metric.
Surface loss gradients also affect pre-band density through transmittance; only labels/mass target are band-local.
Weights .1/.1 are fixed arbitrary attribution settings, not an optimized hyperparameter claim.
A PASS code audit is not proof that real-data gains exist or that finite optimization is globally sufficient.
observability_statistics_interface_revie: PASS: complete8variant x11regions matched; OBS partitions and angle partition of OBS2PLUS; overlapping occluded/conflict masks not treated as partition; null empty masks and strict-null Spearman propagation; overall AbsRel preserved.
scope: Independent read-only scientific implementation review, before formal observability analysis; no real query/media access
